primitives.name: Market Anchoring Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: Resolution order (live-calibration-p.ts): odds-table resolver first (two or more books; exactly one book resolves as `resolver_single_book`), then proof receipt marketFairProb, then factor-breakdown market fair.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_market': 'dimensionless probability anchored to market consensus', 'p_receipt': 'dimensionless probability derived from receipt', 'p_odds_table': 'dimensionless probability from odds table'}
primitives.assumptions: Odds table contains at least two books; single-book case resolves uniquely.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When odds table lacks sufficient coverage or receipt is absent.

primitives.name: Single Book Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: Single-book policy (C-110, 2026-09-06): a receipt-less pick whose game has exactly one real book at/before generatedAt is scored on that book's proportionally de-vigged price, tagged `market_p_single_book`, reported separately from `market_p_from_odds_table`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_single_book': 'dimensionless probability from single book', 'p_devigged': 'de-vigged odds converted to implied probability'}
primitives.assumptions: Exactly one book exists for the game at or before pick generation time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no receipt is available but a single book exists.

layer2.mapping: Derived from market anchoring when resolution fails due to insufficient data.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of picks scored via single-book fallback.

primitives.name: Snapshot Consistency Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: Snapshot rule per real book: latest H2H row with fetchedAt at or before the pick's generatedAt; rows after generatedAt are never read.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_generated': 'timestamp of pick generation', 't_fetched': 'timestamp of book fetch', 'row_t': 'timestamp of row used for snapshot'}
primitives.assumptions: Book data is timestamped and rows are ordered chronologically.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When multiple snapshots exist for a given book.

layer2.mapping: Temporal alignment ensures causal consistency between picks and book data.
layer2.telemetry: Temporal lag between generatedAt and fetchedAt.
